Effect: Ghostly Resonance.name: 效果：幽魂共鸣 Effect: Ghostly Resonance

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-class-feats.Item.QW43JtWz3pVZMsKj]{Elemental Revision}
